selection_rationale: Evaluated on the deduplicated corpus of 166 unique resumes across 25 categories (132 train / 34 test, preventing duplicate-row data leakage from the 962 raw rows). Both Logistic Regression and Linear SVM achieved 88.24% test accuracy (30/34 unseen test resumes). Logistic Regression achieved the highest holdout weighted F1-score (85.50%), while Linear SVM achieved the highest 3-fold Stratified Cross-Validation weighted F1-score (87.16% ± 4.64%).
